_comment: Workbook exercise capstone (docs/workbook/capstone.md): the lbnl-sdahu spliced fault-onset run AHU__onset_damper_stuck_025 (fault-free until 2018-07-01, then the OA damper stuck at 25%) beside the fault-free run AHU__fault_free as its control. Rules: the economizer three of the air-economizer exercise with this unit's own design minimum (a 1.6% OA fraction at its fixed 10% minimum damper position) and its fixed 60 F dry-bulb high limit, both from the dataset template (configs/lbnl-sdahu.json), plus supply_air_control, supply_air_reset and static_pressure_reset so the RCx report has the air-side issues a re-tuning plan must weigh. drift: the ahu family with the first half of 2018 (before the onset) as the frozen baseline and the second half as the current window; `camber drift freeze` writes capstone-baselines.json next to this config, and `camber drift run` scores against it. Freeze only after writing the RCx report: once baselines exist, `camber run` and `camber report` fold the drift verdicts into the findings.
